sharedPitfalls.summary: Catalog V3 only — Catalog V1 is unsupported. A destination created by the current provisioning flow is guaranteed to use V3. For an existing destination, confirm catalogVersion is V3_CATALOG with GET /stores/v3/provision/version before any Stores write; V1_CATALOG halts the run and is never mapped or coded around.
